title: The First Night
pages:
Morning, if you can call it that. I stood at the mouth of the cave and counted what I had left: an axe, a pickaxe, and a few ingots I had not yet learned to melt.

The ground ahead slopes down into timber. Old props, old rails, a mine someone left in a hurry. I can hear water under it, and something green.

I will go down tomorrow. Whatever I find, I will write it here.
